canonical_title: IBM and Together AI sign $240M Nvidia HGX B300 inference cluster deal
aliases: IBM Cloud Together AI HGX B300 cluster
treatment: Repeat only for cluster capacity/availability, customer deployment, pricing/performance, material expansion, or contract change.
known_facts: IBM and Together AI signed a $240 million multi-year agreement for a large-scale AI inference cluster on IBM Cloud.
The cluster uses NVIDIA HGX B300 systems and Spectrum-X Ethernet and targets inference for open models including DeepSeek, MiniMax and Kimi.
